independence_requirement: did not author README.md, docs/paper, docs/claim-evidence.yaml, or tools/claim_evidence.py
reviewer_role: reviewer outside the wording and catalog authorship chain
reviewer_tasks: inspect every headline for promotional or causal wording beyond its row's allowed_wording
check that unrun, undecidable, unattested, hardware_pending, and weakened rows are visibly distinct in every surface
self_attestation: forbidden: owner self-review, synthetic signatures, and admin merges do not satisfy this gate
status: open: no reviewer engaged; nothing here is a review
title: Independent terminology review of promotional and causal wording
what_the_maintainer_may_do: answer documented questions; never edit the reviewer's environment, record, or result in place
what_the_reviewer_signs: a signed machine-readable review record with reviewer identity, role, external timestamp, catalog digest, and one disposition per finding
